notes.title: x360 is open, and it needs names
notes.text: INSEAD has opened the x360 leadership survey on LearningBridge. Your own self-assessment and your observer nominations are due 11 December, and the observers have until the 28th to answer. - Your last day at Locus is 6 December, so name your manager and peers before you lose the colleagues.
acted: Board: added "x360: self-assessment and nominate observers", due 11 December, because its deadline is two weeks earlier than the rest of the PLDP work

notes.title: PPIN questionnaire is open
notes.text: The PPIN questionnaire is now open as part of the PLDP, on Qualtrics, with a deadline of 28 December. You also have to download the response summary at the end and upload it to the PPIN assignment page on the LMS. - The upload is the half people forget.
